note: MashLogic, browser extension, Menlo Park. TechCrunch (2009-06-01): 'Bessemer Venture Partners is incubating the startup and put in most of the original $900,000 in seed money'; the firm's archive dates the investment to September 2006, which replaces the 2009 Form D date. Acquired by Groupon as the New Enterprise Associates book reads it (the firm's exit year is 2013). Graduation left for the graduation pass.

Matrimony.com (formerly Consim Info, BharatMatrimony), Chennai; listed on the NSE since September 2017. INR 10.83B @ ECB 2026-10-01 (INR/EUR 108.832, EUR/USD 1.1298) = $112.4M (stockanalysis.com). The firm's archive dates its investment to September 2011, six years before the listing; no source read names that round. The base row bharat-matrimony is the same company.

MCP Manager, a governance platform for the Model Context Protocol from a New York company founded by Michael Yaroshefsky that earlier built spreadsheet-style workbooks; acq. by Usercentrics, January 2026 (FinSMEs, the firm's listing). The firm's year is 2021; no source read names the round.

MealPal, lunch subscription, New York. Comcast Ventures' post (2017-03-03): 'excited to lead MealPal's Series A round of financing, joined by Bessemer'; the entry date is the firm's own investment date, the announcement came in 2017. The Menlo book reads defunct, but mealpal.com still took sign-ups for New York City on 2026-10-01, so private.

MediBuddy (DocsApp merged with Medi Assist's MediBuddy unit in 2020), online doctor consultations, Bangalore. DocsApp's $7.2M Series A of December 2017 (VCCircle) came from Bessemer and others (Livemint headline); the firm's archive dates the DocsApp investment to 2017-10-27. This row's archive match (2011, NSE: MEDIASSIST) belongs to Medi Assist, a separate row, and is not used; the base row docsapp is this company.

MediSage, online community for doctors, Mumbai (the firm's listing: 'an India-based online community of doctors'). YourStory (2022-04-13) reports $7M 'in first round of institutional fundraise' without a round name, so the stage is undetermined.

Melio, B2B payments for small businesses, New York with its engineering in Tel Aviv; acq. by Xero, agreed June 2025 (the firm's listing, Calcalist). The firm's year is 2018, the founding year; its 2020 post reports $144M 'in several rounds' without naming the one it entered, so undetermined.

MeltPlan, AI preconstruction planning for contractors, Berkeley per its Form D. The firm's own post: 'Bessemer Venture Partners leads MeltPlan's $10 million Seed round' (2026-02-25), which disputes the Series A band read off the size of the February 2026 filing. Entry inside the 24-month window: censored. Momentum check 2026-10-01: no round beyond the seed.

Metalogix, content management tools for SharePoint and Exchange, Washington DC; acq. by Permira, 2014, when Insight and Bessemer 'fully exit their stakes' (Private Equity Wire). Bessemer invested beside Insight in September 2008; no source read names the round or says whether the two took control, which is flagged for a ruling.

Millennial Media, mobile advertising, Baltimore; IPO 2012, acq. by AOL, 2015. The firm's archive dates its investment to July 2006, two months after the founding and the month the Columbia Capital and Acta Wireless directors joined the board (S-1): the Series A, named from knowledge. The 2009 Form D is the Series C that New Enterprise Associates led, not the entry.

Milo.com, local shopping search, Palo Alto; acq. by eBay, 2010. The firm's archive dates its investment to 2009-11-10, the month of the $4M Series A that True Ventures led (named from knowledge; the Felicis book reads Series A from its own listing). The Y Combinator row named Milo is a different company.

Mind Robotics, industrial AI robotics spun out of Rivian, Palo Alto. Orange County Business Journal: 'In late 2025, Mind Robotics raised $115 million in seed funding led by Eclipse', with Bessemer among the other investors (the a16z book dates the seed to November 2025). The $500M Series A of March 2026 graduates the row (TechCrunch), and the $400M round of May 2026 valued it at $3.4 billion (Reuters via CNA), as in the sibling books.

Mindbody, software for fitness studios and spas, San Luis Obispo; IPO 2015, taken private by Vista in 2019. The S-1 names Jeremy Levine the designee of the Series D preferred holders and the firm's memo of July 2010 describes an $11M preferred round, so Bessemer entered at the Series D of August 2010; the Series A band counted only the filings since 2009 and is disputed.

Miter, payroll and workforce software for construction, San Francisco. The firm's post: 'Bessemer Venture Partners co-leads Miter's $38M financing' (2025-05-19); the company's Series B release of 2026-09-30 calls that 'Miter's Series A fundraising round in May 2025' and lists Bessemer as participating again. The 2021 Form D names Connor Watumull as the company's own executive, not a Bessemer seat, so the Seed band is disputed; the firm's listing year is 2025.
Mitigata, cyber risk and insurance platform for Indian enterprises, Bangalore. The firm's own post: 'Bessemer Venture Partners leads Mitigata's $15M Series B' (2026-06-23).

Modelcode.ai, generative AI for modernising legacy code, founded by Michael Fertik; 'Headquartered in New York' (Calcalist, 2025-04-02). The firm's year is 2024; no funding announcement was found, so the round is not named. Momentum check 2026-10-01 (Google News): no priced round at $1B or more.

Moonvalley, licensed AI video models, Toronto (citybiz: 'Toronto's Moonvalley') and Los Angeles. The firm's own post: 'thrilled to co-lead Moonvalley's seed round' (2024-11-18). The later $43M and $84M raises of 2025 carry no round name and do not double the $70M seed; the entry is inside the 24-month window, censored. Reka took over the company in June 2026 (the firm's listing reads acquired, as does the General Catalyst book; Reka's release says the two 'joined forces').

funding_rounds.lead: General Catalyst, Khosla Ventures and Bessemer

note: MotherNature.com, online retailer of vitamins and natural products, Concord MA; IPO December 1999, then wound up ('MotherNature.com Plans to Shut Down', SupplySide Supplement Journal, on the liquidation of late 2000). The firm's list gives 1998 and Bessemer funds filed 13Gs in 2000 and 2001; the round is not named.

Motilal Oswal Financial Services, brokerage and asset manager, Mumbai; listed in September 2007. Avendus records itself as 'Advisor to Motilal Oswal in raising private equity funding from New Vernon Private Equity and Bessemer Venture Partners', and the firm's year is 2006: a private round a year before the listing, so a member under D5 and a pre-IPO entry, Growth. INR 598.71B @ ECB 2026-10-01 (INR/EUR 108.832, EUR/USD 1.1298) = $6.22B (stockanalysis.com).

funding_rounds.lead: New Vernon Private Equity and Bessemer

note: MoveInSync, employee commute software, Bangalore; the firm's India fund post counts it among its startups in India. The firm's own post: 'Bessemer leads MoveInSync's Series C fundraise' (2024-01-25).

Mural Health, participant payments and engagement for clinical trials, Berwyn PA (Form D; Technical.ly calls it Berwyn-based). The firm's listing year is 2022, the year of the company's first $7.5M filing, while the band dates the entry to the 2024 filing that first names Steve Kraus; no source read names either round, so the band is left as it is and the date question is reported.
MyHeritage, online genealogy, Or Yehuda; acq. by Francisco Partners, 2021 (reported $600M). Bessemer led the $25M round of November 2012 (Wikipedia), which agrees with the Growth band.
